blocks.text: Setting up your Mac environment for curriculum design

You do not need a dedicated app to use Google Docs for curriculum designers on Mac. Open your preferred browser and log into your workspace. If you work on the go, install the Google Docs Offline extension in Chrome. This lets you write course outlines even without a stable internet connection. Keep your files organized in Google Drive for desktop to sync your assets directly to your Finder.

Using these shortcuts saves time when you are juggling multiple course projects. When you paste text from a source document or a SME email, always use ⌘ + Shift + V. This prevents unwanted font styles from breaking your document structure. If you need to find a specific formatting tool, press Option + / and type the name of the feature.
Managing SME collaboration in Google Docs

Collaboration with subject matter experts is a major part of your role. Use the suggestion mode to track edits without deleting original content. When a SME provides feedback, use ⌘ + Option + M to add a comment directly on the relevant text. This keeps the conversation focused and prevents long email threads about document changes.
Use the built-in outline feature to navigate long course modules. Click the document outline icon on the top left to jump between sections instantly.
blocks.title: Use the document outline

blocks.text: A single Google Doc supports up to 1.02 million characters. This is plenty for most individual course modules or lesson plans. If your project exceeds this, split the content into separate files. Use a master document to link to your individual modules. This keeps your project manageable and prevents performance lag in your browser.

Curriculum designers must prioritize accessibility. Use the built-in heading styles (Heading 1, Heading 2, etc.) for all your course documents. Select text and use ⌘ + Option + 1 through 6 to apply these styles. This helps screen readers interpret your document structure correctly. Avoid using color as the only way to convey meaning.

When you are in the flow of writing, you can use Lazur to handle the administrative parts of your work. Hold the fn key to dictate course content directly into your document. If you are stuck on a specific section, ask Lazur to help you draft an outline or summarize your research notes. This lets you stay focused on the educational strategy while Lazur handles the typing.

faq.question: Is there a native Google Docs app for Mac?
faq.answer: No. Google Docs is a web-based service. You access it through a browser like Chrome or Safari.

faq.question: How do I work on Google Docs without internet?
faq.answer: You must use the Google Chrome browser and install the Google Docs Offline extension. Enable offline mode in your Google Drive settings.

faq.question: Can I use Google Docs for large curriculum projects?
faq.answer: Yes, but keep in mind the 1.02 million character limit per document. Split very large projects into multiple linked files.
